description: (Tag:fighter)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:worker)(Character)Cancer is the Cancer-constellation Celestial Spirit, a godly hairdresser with incredible agility and dexterity who can cut a whole group's hair before they notice, plus hair magic.
